domain: DataForSEO v3 API mastery — 12 modules and ~200+ endpoints (SERP, Keywords Data, AI Optimization, Domain Analytics, DataForSEO Labs, OnPage, Backlinks, Content Analysis, Merchant, App Data, Business Data, Databases), the task/live queue execution model, and the per-call cost model.
refresh_cadence: monthly for endpoint, parameter, and pricing drift; before every release for cost and authentication claims

researched_requires: at least two captured sources for fast-moving or high-stakes domains
at least one official/primary source for lower-risk domains
retrieved dates, refresh_due dates, source_type, confidence, and claim coverage

sources.title: DataForSEO API v3 documentation
claims: DataForSEO exposes a v3 REST API across 12 modules and ~200+ endpoints
Base production URL is https://api.dataforseo.com/v3

sources.title: DataForSEO pricing
claims: Pay-as-you-go pricing with a $50 minimum deposit, no seats
SERP Standard/Priority/Live priced per query

sources.title: DataForSEO authentication
claims: HTTP Basic auth using base64(login:password)
API password is generated in the API Access tab and differs from the account password

sources.title: DataForSEO status & error codes
claims: 20000 Ok / 20100 Task Created; 40xxx client and 50xxx server codes
Rate limit is 2000 calls/min, 30 simultaneous, <=100 tasks/POST, 120s live timeout

sources.title: DataForSEO sandbox
claims: A free sandbox at sandbox.dataforseo.com returns dummy data with identical schemas
Standard results retained 30 days; raw HTML 7 days; Live not stored

sources.title: DataForSEO user_data
claims: GET /v3/appendix/user_data returns balance, limits, and pricing at no charge

sources.title: DataForSEO Labs overview
claims: Labs serves pre-indexed keyword, competitor, and market data via Live POST
Labs is the cheapest data tier (~$0.01/task observed live 2026-06-26)

sources.title: DataForSEO SERP API overview
claims: SERP API covers Google, Bing, YouTube, Baidu, Yahoo, Seznam, Naver
Methods: Task POST/tasks_ready/Task GET vs Live; Regular/Advanced/HTML

sources.title: DataForSEO Backlinks API overview
claims: Backlinks API is Live POST with bulk endpoints up to 1000 targets
Backlinks require an add-on subscription (observed 40204 without one)

sources.title: DataForSEO OnPage API overview
claims: OnPage runs a task-based crawl plus instant_pages and Lighthouse
instant_pages is the cheapest single-page audit (~$0.0001 live)

sources.title: DataForSEO AI Optimization API overview
claims: AI Optimization covers LLM Responses, LLM Scraper, LLM Mentions, AI Keyword Data
LLM Mentions requires an add-on subscription (observed 40204)

sources.title: DataForSEO MCP server
claims: Official MCP server exposes 10 DataForSEO modules to agents
Configured via DATAFORSEO_USERNAME/PASSWORD and ENABLED_MODULES
